newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates start downward trek.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates start downward trek.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) started to slide on Tuesday after three consecutive sessions of increases, traders said.
This is in line with the anticipated decline in interest rates, traders said.
"The exchange rate has calmed down," a foreign bank dealer said, adding that the Central Bank may soon start lowering its overnight borrowing rate.
Last Thursday and Friday, the Central Bank raised its key rate by a total of 8.75 percentage points to fend off speculation on the peso caused by the problems of the Thai baht.
